speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome.

The lab results confirm this: your albumin is very low (1.8), cholesterol is extremely high (475), and you have massive protein in your urine (4+). The numerous "fatty casts" in your urine and your leg swelling are classic signs of this kidney condition. Can you tell me if you have noticed a lot of foamy urine or any abdominal pain?
